title: RecommendationBinding
description: FROZEN_INTEGRATION.md §2, §6. Composite key checked at execution time, not just consumption time. execute() iff recommendation.binding == current.binding, else reject_as_stale(). campaignId/worldGeneration/featureSchemaVersion/modelDigest/policyVersion require exact equality; worldEpoch is checked against a policy-defined tolerance (default 0).

worldGeneration.description: Incremented on every full CampaignWorld rebuild (replay-from-scratch, schema migration, corruption recovery). Disambiguates epoch reuse across world lifetimes.

worldEpoch.description: Monotonic version of materialized state within one (campaignId, worldGeneration) lifetime.

modelDigest.description: SignedModelArtifact.sha256 — not core_fingerprint/FNV, which is compatibility-only, never authenticity.
